sentences.en: She stood silently, her head tilted slightly to one side.
sentences.zh: 她静静地站着，头微微偏向一侧。

sentences.en: Snow falls silently and piles up ... on top of me.
sentences.zh: 雪无声地落下，积了起来……覆盖在我身上。

sentences.en: A great flight of rooks passed silently over their heads.
sentences.zh: 一大群乌鸦默默地飞过他们的头顶。
